# Procedural Indoor Environments for Robot Simulation

[Nova3D Website](https://nova3d.xyz) · [Open Nova Studio](https://studio.nova3d.xyz)

**20 indoor environments generated by [Nova3D](https://nova3d.xyz/robotics) using the same text prompts as [SceneSmith](https://scenesmith.github.io/). Each scene includes editable Python source, semantic and spatial annotations, articulated joints, physical properties, and exports for Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, and PyBullet.**

The prompts come from the evaluation dataset released with [SceneSmith (ICML 2026)](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v306/pfaff26a.html), by **Nicholas Pfaff, Thomas Cohn, Sergey Zakharov, Rick Cory, and Russ Tedrake** at **MIT and Toyota Research Institute**. Nova3D generated each environment independently from its text prompt. The original scene IDs identify the corresponding SceneSmith examples.

Nova3D represents each environment as a program defining its geometry, layout, materials, and mechanisms. The source and annotations expose object dimensions, joint constraints, and contact properties for inspection and modification.

The collection contains **four living rooms, three dining rooms, two bedrooms, two kitchens, two recreation rooms, and seven specialized settings**: an artist studio, laboratory, library, dental office, server room, pet grooming salon, and bakery.

## Contributions

| Contribution | Released content | Research Applications |
|---|---|---|
| Shared input prompts | Original descriptions and corresponding SceneSmith IDs. | Compare object coverage and spatial arrangements under the same requested scene specification. |
| Editable scene source | Python programs defining geometry, layout, materials, and mechanisms. | Vary object dimensions, placement, and physical parameters. |
| Semantic and spatial annotations | Part IDs, labels, positions, bounds, and dimensions. | Check object counts, spatial relationships, and clearance. |
| Articulation and contact physics | Joint axes, pivots, limits, collision geometry, and body properties. | Configure opening, closing, and object-interaction tasks. |
| Simulator exports | USD, MJCF, SDF, and PyBullet files with their dependencies. | Load and inspect the environments in existing simulation tools. |

## Generation inputs

All 20 scenes were generated from text alone using **GPT-6 Astra**. Each download includes the original prompt. SceneSmith images and meshes were not supplied to Nova3D. [Selection and provenance](https://huggingface.co/datasets/BoooomNing/nova-scenesmith/blob/main/docs/PROVENANCE.md) records the scene IDs, sampling rule, and source revision.

## Access

**[Dataset and downloads](https://huggingface.co/datasets/BoooomNing/nova-scenesmith)** · **[SceneSmith project](https://scenesmith.github.io/)** · **[Paper](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v306/pfaff26a.html)**

Each scene ZIP includes its source, input prompt, annotations, and simulator files with their mesh and texture dependencies.
